title.narrative: Go Digital in Bosnia and Herzegovina

description.narrative: The overall EU4 SMEs Programme aims at strengthening BiHs capacity to generate economic growth and stabilize employment after the COVID crisis. Specifically, this Action will focus on strengthening SMEs access to digital innovations through the availability of SME finance (EBRD credit line EUR 35 mil) and through the EU funded advisory services for the transfer of know-how.
